summary: Sandbach United are on a winning streak and heading to Foley FC looking to make it back-to-back victories to kick off the season. There's plenty to celebrate at the club after Joe Bevan netted a brace in their last match to become the Ramblers' all-time leading scorer with 56 goals, surpassing James Kirby's previous record of 54 in just two seasons. With the whole campaign ahead of him, Bevan will be looking to add even more to that impressive tally.
